metadata.description: Reusable skills and plugins for coding agents.

plugins.name: apple-compliance
plugins.description: Prepare Apple-platform apps for policy review, privacy evidence, signing, metadata, TestFlight, submission and distribution with source-backed checks.

plugins.name: ios-backend-studio
plugins.description: Integrate native iOS and Node.js backends with shared cross-platform contracts, Apple system surfaces, and reproducible Xcode/Mac workflows.

plugins.name: ios-development-studio
plugins.description: A curated iOS development toolkit with focused skills for Swift, SwiftUI, persistence, diagnostics, simulator testing, App Store delivery, and optional Expo, Chat, and Nuke integrations.

plugins.name: mac-developer
plugins.description: Research-backed coding workflows for native macOS apps, Node.js adaptation, background services, browser companions, debugging, and distribution while preserving existing products.

plugins.name: image-prompt-director
plugins.description: Create five detailed, distinct, copy-ready image prompts by default, with reference-aware art direction and model-specific adaptation.

plugins.name: video-prompt-director
plugins.description: Create five detailed video prompt variations by default, with scene-by-scene direction, timed action, reference roles, and continuity controls.

plugins.name: design-variations
plugins.description: Ten fully interactive design variations per round, from small refinements to radical redesigns, with inspiration from connected design-reference MCPs and iteration on your picks.

plugins.name: ui-component-expert
plugins.description: Manual Claude Design export to reviewed React and TypeScript components, with explicit verification and integration gates.

plugins.name: doc-atlas
plugins.description: Evidence-led repository documentation for coding agents: polished READMEs, structured guides, docs sites, API references, diagrams, audits, and maintenance.

plugins.name: issue-assistant
plugins.description: Reconcile Linear or GitHub issues with source-backed evidence, safely recover planned changes, and resolve one issue decision at a time.

plugins.name: ultimate-sdd
plugins.description: Local-first spec-driven development: PRDs, EPICs, REQs, verifiable TASKs, CHANGE deltas, and delivery pipelines.

plugins.name: liquid-glass-studio
plugins.description: Design, implement, tune, and review liquid glass style interfaces: refraction, frost, rim light, motion, native glass APIs, accessibility fallbacks, and performance, with an original engine and a live lab.

plugins.name: creator-intelligence
plugins.description: Find creators, capture their public business contact, vet them with a transparent score, and research their audience and content, from public data only.

plugins.name: freelance-legend
plugins.description: Upwork and freelance toolkit for independent freelancers: elite proposals and cover letters, rule-compliant job scanning across platforms, job vetting and scam checks, pricing and milestones, client communications, profile and portfolio writing, a personal portfolio website, contracts, outreach, and a pipeline ledger.

plugins.name: marketing-page-studio
plugins.description: Build accurate product marketing sites with working interactive demonstrations and browser evidence.

plugins.name: product-demo-studio
plugins.description: Produce evidence-backed product videos, social variants, captions and reproducible render receipts.

plugins.name: seo-geo-god
plugins.description: SEO and GEO for coding agents: detect the stack, fix crawlability, rendering, metadata, structured data, sitemaps, hreflang and AI-crawler access in code, and verify with an offline, stdlib-only audit CLI and CI gates.

plugins.name: deepsec-agent
plugins.description: Local source security review, evidence, baselines, and remediation planning for coding agents.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Source-first security audits with scan planning, scanner-result triage, baseline comparison, and report exports.

plugins.name: ult-accessability
plugins.description: Ultimate web accessibility plugin: WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA audits, contrast and color, remediation, testing, and before/after reports.

plugins.name: ult-performance
plugins.description: Ultimate web performance plugin: measured Core Web Vitals, loading, interaction, media, animation, accessibility, SEO, and quality audits.
